title: yaks id keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/id adds to a component vocabulary. A component declaring `prefix` says its entities wear a human id in that letter's series — a book with prefix B is B-7 — and @yaks/id turns the pair into the id and back.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI naming this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary; a loader registers it with loadVocab(docs, [idKeywords]).

prefix.description: The letter this component's human ids wear: "B" gives B-7. One uppercase letter, unique across the vocabulary — it is what a person types.
